data.action: 抱书差点绊倒扶住书架
data.description: 【杏山和纱 · 古书馆的秘密角落】圣三一静谧的旧古书馆深处，和纱怀里抱着一摞厚厚的甜点食谱，脚下一个踉跄险些被绊倒。她慌张地靠住身旁的书架，黑发与猫耳因受惊而竖起，粉瞳里满是窘迫——「哇啊……！老师，不准笑！我只是想找找古典法式点心的秘方而已……才、才没有冒冒失失的！」
data.promptProse: Kazusa carries a stack of dessert recipe books through the old library, catching herself against a nearby shelf after a stumble and looking embarrassed. Her Trinity blazer, plaid skirt and cat-ear-shaped hood remain in the slightly low medium view. Tall bookshelves form a narrow passage behind the stack. Slanting skylight touches her hair and book corners, revealing dust against the shaded aisle while her hand braces on the shelf.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 古书馆的秘密角落
